basics.name: Nikhil Kodali
basics.label: National Quantum Mission Postdoctoral Fellow
basics.summary: Computational scientist working on relativistic electronic-structure methods, GPU eigensolvers and exascale algorithms, and quantum computing for chemistry. Principal developer of the open-source DFT-FE code.

work.name: Indian Institute of Science, Bengaluru
work.summary: Department of Computational and Data Sciences. National Quantum Mission project SPAARQ (Software Platforms and Algorithms to Accelerate Research in Quantum-HPC), a consortium led by IISc with IIIT Hyderabad, IIT Kanpur and TCS Research (2026-2029).
highlights: Sampling-based quantum computing algorithms for strongly correlated materials, in collaboration with IBM Research

R-ChFSI, an eigensolver with convergence bounds under inexact matrix-vector products

Fe vacancies in monolayer Fe3GeTe2, with Prof. Biplab Sanyal (Uppsala University)
